basic_info.description: Nestled in a prime coastal location, this beautiful 4-bed/1 bath semi-detached home offers  warmth and style with fresh painted, refinished hardwood floors, and classic charm. Enter into the sunlit living rm, where a large picture window welcomes natural light. The adjacent dining and kitchen combo features ample cabinet space, perfect for effortless meal prep and gatherings.     Down the hall, you'll find two comfortable bedrms and a hall bath with a skylight, bringing in soft, natural light. The lower level offers 2 additional beds with newly carpeted floors and a 2nd bath, providing flexibility for guests, a home office, or extended family.    Enjoy outdoor living in the spacious backyard with a patio areaan ideal canvas for gardening, relaxation, or weekend barbecues. The home also includes a 1-car garage with a dedicated laundry area and additional storage space.    Located just minutes from shopping and dining along the Taraval Street corridor, Lakeshore Plaza, and Stonestown Galleriahome to Luckys, Target, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, and a vibrant Sunday Farmers Market. Enjoy the best of coastal and outdoor living with Ocean Beach less than three blocks away, plus nearby access to the SF Zoo, South Sunset Pk, and Pine Lake Pk. Explore scenic trails & Grt Hwy.
